last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription migraine and tension-type headache self-management topics. The main query set returned 181 unique PubMed PMIDs, 181 fetched article records, and 179 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 36229774, 35279587, 36582390, 33315046, 41100087, 27462067, 36526428, 31667736, 29863407, 37234488, 35732505, 9484373, 18984840, 12230594, 14752215, 23195074, 33293189, 31398997, and 29768938. Twenty retained PubMed references were added across 14 new entries. New entries cover aerobic exercise, yoga, tai chi, mindfulness, progressive relaxation, biofeedback, stress management, tension-headache yoga, tension-headache mindfulness, tension-headache acupuncture, riboflavin, feverfew, ginger, and butterbur. Sleep hygiene, regular sleep, migraine acupuncture, spinal manipulation, relaxation, breathing, magnesium, coenzyme Q10, and melatonin topics were linked to existing entries. Breathing exercise, CBT, acupressure, migraine massage, neck exercise, tension-headache aerobic exercise, and tension-headache massage topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
